title: Same GSTIN on more than one party account
why: A GSTIN identifies one registered business per state; two accounts with one GSTIN split that business's ledger and outstanding (or one of them carries someone else's GSTIN, which puts B2B invoices on the wrong recipient in GSTR-1). HQ does not check GSTIN uniqueness.
detectSql:
SELECT CONCAT('GSTIN ', x.g, ' on ', x.cnt, ' accounts: #', x.Act_Id, ' ', RTRIM(x.Act_Name), x.info) Finding, x.Act_Id, x.g Gstin
FROM (SELECT a.Act_Id, a.Act_Name, z.g, CONCAT(' [', RTRIM(a.Act_Type), '] bal ', ABS(b.bal), CASE WHEN b.bal<0 THEN ' Cr' WHEN b.bal>0 THEN ' Dr' ELSE '' END, ', ledger rows ', b.n, ', last ', ISNULL(b.last_,'-'), ', bills ', b.docs, ', open items ', b.openN, ' (', b.openAmt, ')') info, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY z.g) cnt
      FROM dbo.IQAccmst a JOIN dbo.IQAccAdr d ON d.Act_Id=a.Act_Id CROSS APPLY (SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(ISNULL(d.GSTIN,'')),' ',''),CHAR(9),'') g, UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.GSTIN,'')))) gt) z OUTER APPLY (SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.TYPE IN ('D','d','P') THEN b.AMOUNT ELSE -b.AMOUNT END),0) AS numeric(18,2)) bal, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.Doc_ID<>-1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) n, CONVERT(char(10),MAX(CASE WHEN b.Doc_ID<>-1 THEN b.TRDATE END),120) last_, ISNULL(SUM(b.isOpen),0) openN, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(b.isOpen*(b.AMOUNT-ISNULL(b.Adjusted,0))),0) AS numeric(18,2)) openAmt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.IQDoc_Header h WHERE h.Act_ID=a.Act_Id) docs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.IQCash_TRAN c WHERE c.Act_ID=a.Act_Id) cashref FROM (SELECT b0.TYPE, b0.AMOUNT, b0.Adjusted, b0.Doc_ID, b0.TRDATE, CASE WHEN b0.TYPE IN (CASE WHEN a.Act_Type='Supplier' THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END, CASE WHEN a.Act_Type='Supplier' THEN 'R' ELSE 'P' END) AND b0.AMOUNT-ISNULL(b0.Adjusted,0)>0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END isOpen FROM dbo.IQDayBook b0 WHERE b0.Act_ID=a.Act_Id) b) b
      WHERE a.Act_Cat='A' AND a.Act_Type IN ('Customer','Supplier','Customer-Supplier') AND LEN(z.g)>=10) x
WHERE x.cnt>1
ORDER BY x.g, x.Act_Id

title: Different GSTINs with the same PAN (related registrations or typo)
why: Characters 3-12 of a GSTIN are the holder's PAN. Two GSTINs with one PAN are either the same business in two states / a second registration (legal), or one of them is a mistyped copy of the other (e.g. 'CIZ3' vs '1Z3').
detectSql:
SELECT CONCAT('PAN ', x.pan, ': #', x.Act_Id, ' ', RTRIM(x.Act_Name), ' GSTIN ', x.g) Finding, x.Act_Id
FROM (SELECT a.Act_Id, a.Act_Name, z.g, SUBSTRING(z.g,3,10) pan,
             MIN(z.g) OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTRING(z.g,3,10)) gmin, MAX(z.g) OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTRING(z.g,3,10)) gmax
      FROM dbo.IQAccmst a JOIN dbo.IQAccAdr d ON d.Act_Id=a.Act_Id CROSS APPLY (SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(ISNULL(d.GSTIN,'')),' ',''),CHAR(9),'') g, UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.GSTIN,'')))) gt) z
      WHERE a.Act_Cat='A' AND a.Act_Type IN ('Customer','Supplier','Customer-Supplier') AND LEN(z.g)>=12) x
WHERE x.gmin<>x.gmax
ORDER BY x.pan, x.Act_Id

title: Party carries the firm's own GSTIN (or the sister firm's)

SELECT CONCAT('#', a.Act_Id, ' ', RTRIM(a.Act_Name), ' [', RTRIM(a.Act_Type), '] has GSTIN ', z.g, ' = ', f.firm) Finding, a.Act_Id

title: PAN field disagrees with the PAN inside the GSTIN

detectSql:
SELECT CONCAT('#', a.Act_Id, ' ', RTRIM(a.Act_Name), ': PAN ', LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Act_PAN)), ' vs GSTIN ', z.g) Finding, a.Act_Id
FROM dbo.IQAccmst a JOIN dbo.IQAccAdr d ON d.Act_Id=a.Act_Id CROSS APPLY (SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(ISNULL(d.GSTIN,'')),' ',''),CHAR(9),'') g, UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.GSTIN,'')))) gt) z
WHERE a.Act_Cat='A' AND a.Act_Type IN ('Customer','Supplier','Customer-Supplier') AND LEN(z.g)=15 AND LTRIM(ISNULL(d.Act_PAN,''))<>'' AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Act_PAN)))<>SUBSTRING(z.g,3,10)

why: Act_BillMode 0 (Cash) makes HQ's bill screen default to cash for the party: the bill goes to 'Cash on hand' and only the IQCash_TRAN copy names the party, so the party ledger and outstanding never show those sales. 798 of 952 MBM parties (759 of them created before 2024) and 37 of 74 MP parties have bill mode Cash; the form's default for new accounts is Credit.

why: HQ's balances, ledgers and the account screen read the opening from the IQDayBook Doc_Id=-1 rows; IQAccmst.Act_OPbal/Act_OpSign is only a copy. Where they differ, the account screen shows the ledger figure and the next save silently overwrites the master figure, so one of the two numbers is wrong and nobody sees it.
detectSql:
SELECT CONCAT('#', a.Act_Id, ' ', RTRIM(a.Act_Name), ' [', RTRIM(a.Act_Type), ']: master ', ISNULL(a.Act_OPbal,0), ' ', ISNULL(a.Act_OpSign,''), ' vs opening rows ', ABS(ISNULL(o.net,0)),
  CASE WHEN o.net<0 THEN ' C' WHEN o.net>0 THEN ' D' ELSE '' END, ' (', o.n, ' rows)') Finding, a.Act_Id
FROM dbo.IQAccmst a
